rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core decision: counts stay untouched, sva estimates surrogate variables with ~condition as the full model and ~1 as the null, they enter the DESeq2 design as ~SV1..SVk + condition, and each SV is checked against condition, cluster label and library size; ComBat/removeBatchEffect are explicitly excluded, and edgeR QL on the same design serves as a cross-check. It first verifies that the two clusters are balanced across condition and halts inference if confounded, which is exactly the estimability check the reference requires. It falls short of the reference by never asking the analyst for the unrecorded variable (extraction date, lane) before resorting to SVA, and it caps k at 2 rather than taking it purely from the estimator, though it states the reason. QC, filtering, in-model normalization, explicit reference level and contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and the report contents are all specified; the fdrtool null re-estimation is an unnecessary addition. Enrichment was not requested, but the plan runs it correctly (full ranked list by Wald statistic, tested-gene universe, named collections with releases, 15-500 window, seed recorded).
